description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended dostarlimab for the treatment of adults with advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer with high microsatellite instability or mismatch repair deficiency who have had platinum-based chemotherapy. Dostarlimab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the managed access agreement conditions available to the NHS.
